concept: 비가 잠시 그친 한낮 항구 정비 공간에서 출항 전 수리 키트를 확인하며 기능성 조끼 옆끈을 마무리 조정하는 여성
provenance: Independent general knowledge and random scene synthesis, before project-local candidates

decision_rules.pass: The entire relationship and identifiable same-garment endpoints are visible in native pixels.
decision_rules.partial_or_hidden: FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS; prompt/audit validity alone is insufficient.

test_gates.expected: Close-fitting charcoal cotton jersey is identifiable as the inner T-shirt along the ribs, distinct from vest and rain jacket.
Base is close, vest structured, outer nylon jacket roomy; visible layer edges and differential fabric slack.
Two near-side webbing bridges connect front and back panels of the same olive vest through separate buckles; both stitched endpoints visible for each.
Right fingers pinch the free tail after the lower buckle, leaving buckle and attachment loops observable.
Lower vest zipper joined to sternum, upper V opening showing the T-shirt; zipper parts belong to the same vest.
Open crinkled nylon jacket surrounds the vest; near panel opens away from the side connection and cuff is wrist-fastened.
Observed reference face and dark bob with wispy bangs guide visible appearance; pose and outfit are independent.
Open repair kit, rain traces and harbor alcove support a gear-check pause; gesture and inviting glance remain readable.

post_retrieval_gates.expected: The blue jacket shoulder boundaries extend beyond the same woman's shoulder joints; wide sleeves and a broad torso share its oversized proportions with visible inner-layer clearance.

On the same olive vest, each front fabric anchor and rear fabric anchor visibly attaches its own webbing section; the two sections join through a central buckle. Both endpoints, paths and fastening are visible in the same saved image.

postcomposition_local_pose_note: Fingers moved below the fastening line, preserving the independent free-tail adjustment and both same-vest endpoints. Camera side explicitly right-front; both changes are authorial open staging.
positive_repair: Fold the same blue near jacket panel and lining behind shoulder and hip, exposing olive rear fabric strip; slightly more lateral near-front camera direction; keep worn vest and lower free-tail pinch.
original_case_scope_note: Original actor-right staging remains authorial; the neutral preserved retry describes the same near hand. Original 8 gate expectations remain recorded, and any native mismatch will be reported rather than silently rewritten.
